[SWS_FrNm_00572]
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_02572
⌈If FrNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to TRUE and FrNm_Deacti-
vateTxPnShutdownMsg is called with a valid NM-Channel (nmChannelHandle), then
the FrNm module shall set PNSR bit in the CBV to 0 on the given NM-channel and
return with E_OK.⌋
